description: This file defines a report parser class for generating crossovered analytic reports in Odoo, including methods for retrieving and processing analytic account data and lines.

classes.name: crossovered_analytic
classes.description: A report parser class for crossovered analytic reports, providing methods to fetch and process analytic account data and lines.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with helper methods and variables.

methods.name: find_children
methods.description: Finds child analytic accounts of given reference IDs, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: set_account
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all child account IDs for given categories.

methods.name: _ref_lines
methods.description: Generates reference lines with aggregated amounts and quantities for a given form input.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Generates detailed analytic lines grouped by account, including percentage calculations relative to a base amount.
